news.title: Carrick carrying on but senior Man Utd figures concerned by performances
news.description: While head coach Michael Carrick is expected to be in charge for Sunday's match against Bournemouth, Manchester United begin the process of identifying possible replacements.

news.title: Breaking down Man Utd's tactics after Fernandes' criticism
news.description: Was Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes correct in his analysis of his side's tactics in their 4-1 thrashing by Italian side Como?

news.title: 'Not what a captain should be' - the debate around Fernandes' outburst
news.description: Bruno Fernandes' comments after Manchester United's humbling by Como have got fans and pundits talking - but what now for the captain?

news.title: Fernandes rounds on Carrick after Man Utd humiliation
news.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes blames head coach Michael Carrick for the tactics that led to an embarrassing 4-1 defeat by Como in the Champions League.

news.title: Man Utd humbled by four-goal Como to pile pressure on Carrick
news.description: Manchester United suffer a heavy defeat to a Como side playing just their third ever game of Champions League football, as Nico Paz stars for the hosts to pile the pressure on Michael Carrick.

news.title: From Bury to AC Milan: Bournemouth's journey to 'dreamland'
news.description: Fifteen years to the day after they lost at home to Bury in League One, Bournemouth host seven-time champions of Europe AC Milan in the Europa League.

news.title: Saka injury 'does not look good' - how will Arsenal cope?
news.description: Mikel Arteta says the quadriceps injury Arsenal's Bukayo Saka picked up in the Champions League draw with Bayern Munich "does not look good at all".

news.title: Goal, assist... goal-kick - Kane underlines Ballon d'Or credentials
news.description: Why Declan Rice backs his England team-mate Harry Kane to win the Ballon d'Or after Arsenal's draw with Bayern Munich in the Champions League.

news.title: Third-longest serving manager in top 92 clubs Woodman leaves Bromley
news.description: Bromley part company with manager Andy Woodman following a challenging start to the 2026-27 season.

news.title: Rice strikes to earn Arsenal draw at Bayern
news.description: Declan Rice scores a late equaliser as Arsenal and Bayern Munich play out an entertaining draw in the league phase of the Champions League while Bukayo Saka limps off with an early injury.
